data.name: Arjin
data.gender_notes: Arjin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arjin is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'arjuna', which means 'white, pure, and righteous'. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna is a great warrior and one of the central characters in the Mahabharata epic. The name Arjin carries the meaning “Brave, righteous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arjin usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, righteous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Arjin belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, righteous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arjin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Arjin pulls inspiration from the legendary character Arjuna in Hindu mythology. Arjuna's journey in the Mahabharata epic recounts his transformation from a troubled warrior to a virtuous and righteous hero. Belonging to the Pandava dynasty, Arjuna's strength, courage, and loyalty epitomize the qualities an ideal leader should possess. The name Arjin carries the rich cultural heritage and tradition of ancient India and the valor of its legendary heroes.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arjin is deeply rooted in spirituality and signifies purity and righteousness. Arjuna's devotion towards Lord Krishna, as recorded in the Bhagavad Gita, is a source of inspiration for countless individuals, helping them in their spiritual journey. Arjin's spiritual significance lies in the reminder of the importance of staying true to one's principles and beliefs to live a virtuous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Arjun signifies the pure and devotional warrior. His name is derived from Arjuna, the legendary hero in Mahabharata, who was guided by Lord Krishna. The name Arjun symbolizes unwavering dedication, strong determination, and the courage to pursue one's dharma.
